changes.comment: Remove AgentRuntimeProviderCapabilities and provider getCapabilities; configured runtimes own selection metadata. Nonempty Channel tool text is now the complete model-visible result: providers must include actionable facts and reminders. Omitted or empty text exposes the structured value. Text-capable tools must omit outputSchema; schema-plus-text results fail SDK validation after execution. Add optional AgentActivityPage.transcriptPath and per-record native turnId. These facts are provider-owned; absent evidence must stay absent.
